newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Off 0.100 to 1.000 cent. Bearisly construed Cattle-on-Feed report and concern over E.coli in hamburger.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Corn futures called lower but likely follow lead of live cattle.
LEAN HOGS - Off 0.200 to 0.400 cent. Carryover from limit losses Friday and weak cash markets.
PORK BELLIES - Off 0.300 to 0.750 cent. Carryover from limit losses and August premium to cash.
